During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''admiral''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]] ''[[Long Shot]]'' was supposed to be the admiral's, until it was stolen by agents of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]].
